artworks.title: A Barn
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Abraham Bloemaert after Boëtius Adams Bolswert
artworks.description: The image shows a thatched-roof hut with a surrounding rural setting. The hut is featured prominently with a low horizon line, showcasing trees and hills in the distance. The etching technique creates detailed textures in the roof and foliage. The monochromatic color palette uses varying shades of brown and black. A figure is depicted near a wooden structure, possibly a well. Trees frame the hut with delicate strokes hinting at movement.

artworks.title: Castle (Warmond?)
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a historical townscape from an elevated point of view. A small boat with a man and a flag is seen on the water, along with reeds and swans. In the background is a castle or large estate with detailed architectural features. A bridge crosses the water, leading to more buildings and trees. The artwork is detailed with fine brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Road with Barn and Cottages
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from a countryside setting. There are cottages, a winding path, trees, birds, a man leaning on a spade, and some structures in the distance. The landscape is detailed in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: Cover for "Au pied du Sinaï"
artworks.artist: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated position. The horizon is high, with a sun and clouds in the sky. Mountains partially obscure the horizon line. The artwork uses textured lines and shading for shapes. The color palette consists of earthy tones and yellows. In the foreground, a ridge slopes downwards where a figure is present. Dark structures with rough outlines are visible below the ridge. In the distance, there are gentle slopes and plains leading to the horizon.

artworks.title: Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is positioned in a slight three-quarter view, facing somewhat forward. His facial features include a serious expression with a slightly parted lip and steady gaze. He has voluminous, curly hair that frames his face and extends past his shoulders. He is dressed in a robe-like garment with wide, billowy sleeves and a lighter-colored shirt with a visible collar. In one hand, he holds a painter's palette and brushes. Surrounding him is an ornate architectural frame with decorative carvings on the sides. Inside the frame, there is a partially visible canvas or backing behind him. At the bottom, there is a stone or plaque with engraved text. The background is dark, highlighting the man's figure and the objects around him.

artworks.title: Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person seated behind a ledge. The individual has a high forehead, a straight nose, slightly pursed lips, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. They have curly hair peeking out from under a fabric headpiece. The person wears a voluminous garment with textured fabric, dramatic folds, and decorative cuffs. They hold drawing tools and are positioned in front of an architectural background with engraved inscriptions below the ledge.

artworks.title: The Vision (L'apparition)
artworks.artist: Claude Lorrain
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with dense vegetation viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A distant building, possibly a castle or manor, is faintly visible on the horizon. The brushstrokes or etching technique is intricate with fine lines and detailed cross-hatching creating texture in the foliage and ground. The color palette is monochromatic in tones of brown or sepia, giving an antique feel. Trees and shrubs dominate the foreground with intertwining branches, leading the eye towards the distant building on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Anne
artworks.artist: Lorenzo Baldissera Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure surrounded by other figures and clouds. The image portrays a dramatic scene with a bearded figure at the top, one hand raised. Below, other figures are arranged in a dynamic composition. The background includes clouds and a hint of landscape with a building. The style of the drawing suggests it could be associated with the artist Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Setting Sun over Antwerp Harbor (Soleil couchant - port d'Anvers)
artworks.artist: Johan Barthold Jongkind
artworks.description: The image shows a sunset over a body of water with several ships in the distance. A small boat with a figure paddling is seen in the foreground. The artwork is done in a sketch-like style with dynamic brushstrokes, creating texture in the sky and water. The color palette is monochromatic in dark brown and beige tones. Faint outlines of buildings can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: Salvator Mundi
artworks.artist: French 15th Century or Master EMR ?
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a figure with long, reddish-brown hair. The person has deep-set eyes, a neatly trimmed beard, and is dressed in a red garment with gold accents. They wear a yellow sash, hold a golden orb with a cross, and have a raised hand gesture. A golden halo surrounds the person's head. The background is neutral, bordered by a thick black frame with an "IHS" monogram in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Bird Dropping Blinding Tobit
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed landscape from a high vantage point, showcasing a bustling rural scene. The horizon line is near the top of the image, partially hidden by rolling hills and distant mountains. The artwork shows intricate textures through fine lines and hatching, particularly in the foliage and buildings. It has a monochromatic color palette of black and white, emphasizing lines and shapes. A tree is close to us on the right, next to a building with a woman outside. Various animals and small figures are dispersed through the middle area, leading towards a town with clustered buildings and two windmills. In the distance, the landscape continues with trees, hills, and architectural elements. The sky contains clouds and birds, adding depth and movement.

artworks.title: Tobias Taking Leave of his Parents
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a village scene. In the foreground, figures are gathered near a building, with a dog and scattered objects nearby. The village has various houses leading to a church tower in the center. In the distance, there are rolling hills and more buildings. The artwork features fine line work and cross-hatching, using a monochromatic palette dominated by soft greys, with swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Tobias Catching the Fish in the River Tigris
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view with a detailed townscape extending into the distance. Mountains and buildings obscure the low horizon. Rocky outcroppings and small structures are scattered in the distance. The artwork features intricate linework typical of etching, with fine cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white tones for contrast. Closest to us are rocks, trees, and a whimsically shaped tree with figures engaged in various activities. Further back, there are more buildings and ships, creating a busy town by the water.

artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel Arriving at Raguel's House
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A group of people stands near a grand building on the left side, while the sprawling cityscape includes various buildings, trees, and roads leading to the horizon. The horizon features a view of the sea with ships and a city with steeples and towers. Clouds are illustrated with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black highlighting the detailed line work. Textured brushstrokes convey depth and intricacy in the distance.

artworks.title: The Homecoming of Tobias
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a bustling village scene viewed from an elevated vantage point. Various buildings, including towers and spires, are surrounded by rock formations. The sky above is filled with swirling cloud formations. The scene is rendered in monochrome, with varying shades of gray. Figures are visible near a house, engaging in various activities. The village extends into the distance, with trees, livestock, and additional buildings leading towards the horizon.

artworks.title: The Departure of the Angel
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etched landscape with a thatched-roof house, two kneeling figures, animals, a winged figure soaring upwards, a horizon with mountains and castles, and a bustling settlement with cottages, towers, and a church. The artwork showcases intricate details and fine lines to portray the various elements in a classic monochrome palette, highlighting textures and depth within the scene.

artworks.title: Abraham Paying Tithes to Melchisedek
artworks.artist: Battista Franco
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures and animals engaged in different activities. Some figures are carrying objects, and there is a focus on an elephant and a lion on an elevated surface. In the foreground, a dog is seated, while the background shows trees. The artwork features intricate line work and shading, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The figures, animals, and objects are depicted in motion, capturing a frozen moment in time.

artworks.title: The Standard Bearer
artworks.artist: Monogrammist FG
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in detailed armor reminiscent of the Renaissance era. The figure is standing upright with a serious expression, holding a sword in one hand and another object in the other. A large, feathered hat sits on his head, with a pronounced beard visible. The background includes a castle-like structure on the left side, set against a rugged landscape with a winding path or river leading towards it. The scene is completed with clouds in the sky and a lush landscape featuring trees and patterned ground. A panel behind the figure is inscribed with the date "1537" and initials.

artworks.title: Pan Taming Eros
artworks.artist: Agostino Carracci
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with mythological figures in a pastoral landscape. The drawing shows a satyr and a cherubic figure with wings engaging playfully, while two reclining figures observe from a short distance. The satyr kneels on the ground as the cherub pulls his ear. Nearby, two figures rest together, watching the scene. The figures are detailed, and trees frame the composition. In the background, there is a hilly terrain under a cloudy sky. Cross-hatching is used throughout the drawing for texture.

artworks.title: Wild Horse Coming out of the Water (Cheval sauvage)
artworks.artist: Eugène Delacroix
artworks.description: This is an image of a rearing horse. The horse is depicted in mid-motion, rearing up with its mane flowing backwards. The drawing is in black and white, with expressive lines showing the horse's movement and the environment. The image conveys energy and tension, with emphasis on the horse's muscles and background lines. The horse's anatomy is detailed, giving a lifelike quality to the drawing.

artworks.title: The Defeat of Sennacherib
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving horses and figures. The composition features powerful horses in motion, detailed rendering of their musculature and expressions, and figures dressed in elaborate clothing, some holding weapons. In the background, the sky is dark and turbulent, and an angelic figure is depicted in the clouds. The drawing uses chiaroscuro to enhance the depth and intensity.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child at Left, with a File of Angels
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape scene with figures and a donkey. The image features an outdoor setting with tall, leafy trees in the background and a series of figures gathered along a path. A man is leading a donkey loaded with a large, woven basket. To the left, there are multiple figures, some with wings, seemingly interacting with the man and the donkey. The sky has birds and wispy clouds, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Four Saints of the Benedictine Order
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals. In the center, there is an elderly man with a halo above his head, his hands joined in prayer. Surrounding him are other figures, including a woman kneeling with her hands near her heart. On the left, a cherubic face appears. The background features radiating lines and a curved arch.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Sword
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
artworks.description: The image features an etched portrait of an elderly man facing forward, with his upper body occupying the central portion of the frame. He has a serious expression, deep-set eyes, a long, full beard, unruly hair, and is wearing a robe with a dark fur-like collar. In his right hand, he holds a slender rod or staff. The background is filled with dense cross-hatching, emphasizing the details of the man’s face and upper body.
